title: Fancytree Options
description: Configuration options for the Fancytree jQuery widget.

activeVisible.description: Make sure active nodes are visible (expanded).

autoActivate.description: Automatically activate a node when it is focused using the keyboard.

autoCollapse.description: Automatically collapse all siblings when a node is expanded.

autoScroll.description: Automatically scroll nodes into the visible area.

clickFolderMode.description: Behavior when clicking a folder node: 1 = activate, 2 = expand, 3 = activate and expand, 4 = activate (double-click expands).

debugLevel.description: Debug logging level: 0 = quiet, 1 = errors, 2 = warnings, 3 = infos, 4 = debug.

focusOnSelect.description: Set focus when a node is checked by a mouse click.

idPrefix.description: Prefix used to generate node ids, e.g. `<span id='fancytree-id-KEY'>`.

minExpandLevel.description: Minimum expansion level. 1 = the root node is not collapsible.

quicksearch.description: Navigate to the next node by typing the first letters.

tabindex.description: Tabindex for the tree. The whole tree behaves as one single control.

titlesTabbable.description: Node titles can receive keyboard focus.

tooltip.description: Use the node title as a tooltip. A callback could also be specified.

sourceArticle.title: wiki article
sourceArticle.description: wiki article with json content model with content compatible as FancyTree data source
